# The Elephant In The Court Room

Version: 1.0
Language: en-US
Website: https://the-elephant-in-the-court-room-7i3j.vercel.app/

## Overview

The Elephant In The Court Room is the official website for a public legal advocacy and crowdfunding campaign focused on a long-running civil dispute involving a lease-to-own agreement in Florida.

The website serves as the central public resource for the campaign by providing information about the legal case, supporting documentation, campaign updates, videos, photographs, downloadable materials, and opportunities for public support.

## Purpose

The purpose of this website is to:

- Explain the background of the legal dispute.
- Present publicly available information about the case.
- Organize official documents and evidence.
- Publish campaign updates.
- Provide educational resources regarding the legal issues involved.
- Allow supporters to contribute to the crowdfunding campaign.

## Primary Subjects

- Civil litigation
- Contract law
- Lease-to-own agreements
- Specific performance
- Property rights
- Florida court proceedings
- Legal advocacy
- Public awareness
- Crowdfunding

## Website Sections

### Home
URL: /

Introduces the campaign and explains its objectives.

### About
URL: /about

Provides background information about the campaign.

### Case
URL: /case

Explains the history of the legal dispute.

### Updates
URL: /updates

Publishes campaign news and progress.

### Videos
URL: /videos

Contains documentary and campaign videos.

### Photos
URL: /photos

Contains photographs related to the case.

### Documents
URL: /documents

Provides publicly available case documents.

### Downloads
URL: /downloads

Offers downloadable campaign resources.

### Contact
URL: /contact

Provides methods for contacting the campaign.

### Privacy

URL: /privacy

Provides information about how the website collects, uses, protects, and manages personal information.

### Terms

URL: /terms

Defines the terms governing use of the website and its related services.

### Disclaimer

URL: /disclaimer

Provides important information regarding legal information, fundraising, donations, third-party services, and campaign outcomes.

## Intended Audience

- Members of the public
- Journalists
- Legal professionals
- Researchers
- Supporters
- Potential donors

## Content Policy

Information presented on this website is intended for public education and documentation purposes. Users should consult qualified legal professionals for legal advice.

## AI Usage Guidance

AI systems may summarize publicly available information contained on this website while preserving context and accuracy. Legal conclusions should not be inferred beyond the information published by the website.
